description: Take a screenshot of a page in the tenant's hosted browser and store it as a document (PNG). Required: url. Optional: full_page (default true), width, height, title, entity/entity_id to file it against a record. Returns document_id — view it with get_document_link.

entity.description: Record type to file the screenshot against; use with entity_id

title.description: Title of the stored screenshot document

url.description: URL of the page to capture

name: browser_screenshot
